title: Natural derived global cup calculated in a K-injective target
statement: For a scheme X let S=Γ(X,-), T its termwise action, R its unbounded right derived functor, and β:T followed by Q→Q followed by R the transported right-derived unit. There exists a natural family μ_AB:RA tensor^L RB→R(A tensor^L B). For all integer complexes K,L and every K-injective complex I, and every chain pairing φ:Tot(K tensor L)→I, the composite (β_K tensor β_L), μ_QK,QL, R(Q_tensor_comparison(K,L) followed by Qφ) equals Q_tensor_comparison(TK,TL), Q(moduleCup_naiveMap(K,L) followed by Tφ), β_I. The naive cochain map here is the concrete coproduct construction of [lem-sc-module-cup-naive-map-chain]. No restriction on K,L or on φ beyond its displayed type is imposed.

proof.text: For the ringed-space morphism to (pt,Γ(X,O_X)), use the derived pullback/direct-image adjunction of lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-adjoint-general, transported through def-pc-global-derived-rhom. Use the canonical bifunctorial tensor isomorphism of lem-sc-module-cup-global-tensor-pullback. This node constructs ordinary pullback via point evaluation, inverse image and change of rings, fixes its tensor constraint by the ordinary evaluation equation, and normalizes the derived tensor isomorphism on K-flat representatives. Transpose that tensor comparison followed by the tensor of the counits to define μ. Naturality of the counits and of the comparison proves naturality of μ.

Fix K,L,I,φ with I K-injective. Compute R(QI) by QΓ(I). Resolve the two complexes of global sections by K-flat complexes and take the derived pullback transpose of each displayed composite. By lem-sc-module-cup-global-counit-comparison the counit of the induced derived adjunction composed with the right-derived unit equals the derived-to-ordinary pullback comparison followed by ordinary evaluation. Its absolute-derived-functor hypotheses hold by the absolute K-flat comparison in lem-sc-module-cup-global-tensor-pullback and by the K-injective construction of RΓ. lem-sc-module-cup-global-tensor-comparison supplies the full tensor polygon for arbitrary complexes, with the same comparison maps and the K-flat normalization furnished by lem-sc-module-cup-global-tensor-pullback. Both transposes on each summand are ordinary evaluation on tensor sections, followed by φ. The coproduct formula of lem-sc-module-cup-naive-map-chain identifies this with the naive pairing. The adjunction Hom equivalence is injective, so the transposes give equality. Transport back by β_I gives the displayed equation. This is the polygon argument of Tag 0FP3 with its final map composed with φ; the K-injective target ensures every final morphism is represented by an actual chain map.

theorem moduleCup_exists_kinjective_target_pairing :
    let S := RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor X.toRingedSpace
    let T := S.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)
    let R := S.rightDerivedFunctor
    ∃ μ : ∀ A B : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)),
        R.obj A ⊗ R.obj B ⟶ R.obj (A ⊗ B),
      (∀ (A A' B B' : DerivedCategory
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)))
        (f : A ⟶ A') (g : B ⟶ B'),
        (R.map f ⊗ₘ R.map g) ≫ μ A' B' = μ A B ≫ R.map (f ⊗ₘ g)) ∧
      ∀ (K L I : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
        [I.IsKInjective] (φ : K ⊗ L ⟶ I),
        ((moduleCup_comparisonNatTrans X).app K ⊗ₘ
          (moduleCup_comparisonNatTrans X).app L) ≫
          μ (DerivedCategory.Q.obj K) (DerivedCategory.Q.obj L) ≫
            R.map (Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ DerivedCategory.Q K L ≫
              DerivedCategory.Q.map φ) =
          Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ DerivedCategory.Q (T.obj K) (T.obj L) ≫
            DerivedCategory.Q.map (moduleCup_naiveMap X K L ≫ T.map φ) ≫
              (moduleCup_comparisonNatTrans X).app I
